No extra rerun is used to hide this limitation.

Scope and banner/full-name/card/dialog findings use actual paint and viewport/ancestor clips; a narrow width cap alone is not a finding. Exact JSON first/middle/final ranges are all reachable by existing native scroll, including horizontal dialog scroll; no unreachable JSON-tail assertion.

Near-stale CPU card messages update through original one-second monotonic aging while a control is held. No injected clock or whole-budget amount acceptance. Metadata 30-second throttle/wrong-host branch and greater-than-2^53 context revisions are source-only in this inventory; exact wide quantities in records are sampled.

Known bounded six-resource, seven-own/eight-all-lease snapshots and metadata are representative; no first200/full200/max4MiB/depth64/256000-display-cap stress, full arbitrary prose, universal identity roster or permission correctness proof.

Pending exact close/disconnect and public dispose ignore late replies. Runtime browser RDF/LDES was not exported and memory wiping is not established. Original awaited context/browser/server API closes and read release are not OS process-group exit/reap evidence. CPU/memory targets are not hard enforcement/measurement; no ARM enrollment/lease claim.

No live paired hosts, node_open, grant/contact/publication changes, Screen Sharing, credential or clipboard operation. Bootstrap values are synthetic only; malformed/wrong-scope replies are deliberate adversarial fixture data, never authority. TUI/Linux/upgrade/full UX remain open.
